# Dependencies for the `json-schemas` and `dependency-hygiene` quality gates
# (scripts/ci/check_json_schemas.py and scripts/ci/check_dependency_hygiene.py).
# Hash-pinned and installed explicitly: json-schemas fails closed when jsonschema
# is absent, preventing a silently degraded parse-only pass (HELM-374).
#
# Hashes cover the wheels pip resolves on the CI runner, so refresh them there,
# not on a dev machine — rpds-py ships per-platform wheels and a macOS hash will
# fail the install. `--require-hashes` also needs the full transitive closure
# pinned, which is why `typing-extensions` is here: `referencing` pulls it in on
# python < 3.13. Regenerate jsonschema's closure on Linux/x86_64 CPython 3.12:
#   pip download --only-binary=:all: -d /tmp/w jsonschema==<new> && pip hash /tmp/w/*
# PyYAML includes Linux CPython 3.12 wheel hashes for x86_64 and aarch64; refresh
# both when updating it. This does not add aarch64 hashes for rpds-py.
jsonschema==4.26.0 \
    --hash=sha256:d489f15263b8d200f8387e64b4c3a75f06629559fb73deb8fdfb525f2dab50ce
jsonschema-specifications==2025.9.1 \
    --hash=sha256:98802fee3a11ee76ecaca44429fda8a41bff98b00a0f2838151b113f210cc6fe
referencing==0.37.0 \
    --hash=sha256:381329a9f99628c9069361716891d34ad94af76e461dcb0335825aecc7692231
attrs==26.1.0 \
    --hash=sha256:c647aa4a12dfbad9333ca4e71fe62ddc36f4e63b2d260a37a8b83d2f043ac309
rpds-py==2026.6.3 \
    --hash=sha256:ecabd69db66de867690f9797f2f8fa27ba501bbc24540cbdbdc649cd15888ba6
typing-extensions==4.16.0 \
    --hash=sha256:481caa481374e813c1b176ada14e97f1f67a4539ce9cfeb3f350d78d6370c2e8
# Dependabot coverage parses YAML rather than matching configuration text.
PyYAML==6.0.3 \
    --hash=sha256:ba1cc08a7ccde2d2ec775841541641e4548226580ab850948cbfda66a1befcdc \
    --hash=sha256:9149cad251584d5fb4981be1ecde53a1ca46c891a79788c0df828d2f166bda28
